scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/shared typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: bun run lint && bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration && bun run test:ui
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --config apps/api/vitest.config.ts --project api-unit && vitest run --config scripts/vitest.config.ts --project deploy-unit && vitest run --config apps/web/vitest.config.ts --project web-unit
scripts.test:integration: vitest run --config apps/api/vitest.config.ts --project api-integration --project api-staging-sim --project api-production-gate && vitest run --config scripts/vitest.config.ts --project deploy-integration
